title: Tom's Basement - Videos
description:
Welcome to a space dedicated to DIY, 3D printing and electronics enthusiasts! If you're a maker or just curious, you've come to the right place. From my basement, I share my projects: home automation with Home Assistant, tutorials in French on Klipper, tests and presentations of 3D printers, as well as practical tips for all levels.

As a committed open-source supporter, I highlight projects such as Voron and Orca Slicer. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, you'll find plenty here to feed your creativity and improve your skills.

Join me to discover DIY ideas, develop your knowledge of 3D printing and home automation, and take part in a community that's passionate about creation!
